text: data data frame containing interim survival data, censored df_cens_time, columns: time Final observed/event time interim (analysis time scale). group Treatment group indicator (e.g. "Control", "Treatment"). rec_time Recruitment (calendar) time. pseudo_time time + rec_time (calendar time event/censoring). status Event indicator interim (1 = event, 0 = censored). survival_time Observed follow-time randomisation event/censoring interim. posterior_df data frame posterior samples columns: lambda_c, delay_time HR, corresponding control hazard, delay (changepoint) time post-delay hazard ratio, respectively, plus gamma_c (Weibull shape) control_distribution = "Weibull". control_distribution Distributional form assumed control arm: either "Exponential" (default) "Weibull". n_c_planned Planned maximum number patients control group. n_t_planned Planned maximum number patients treatment group. rec_time_planned Planned maximum recruitment calendar time full trial. df_cens_time Calendar time df censored (interim analysis time). analysis_model named list specifying analysis method decision rule: method: e.g. "LRT", "WLRT", "MW". alpha: one-sided type error level (used legacy fallback path, see censoring_model ). alternative_hypothesis: direction alternative (e.g. "one.sided"). rho, gamma, t_star, s_star: additional parameters WLRT MW (applicable). censoring_model Legacy fallback, deprecated (see Deprecated section). Used future_boundaries NULL. named list specifying single censoring mechanism future data (method: one "Time", "Events", ""; plus corresponding time/events/parameter), success determined analysis_model$alpha rather design-specific critical value. future_boundaries Recommended. list future, pre-specified, fixed decision points evaluate posterior-predictive draw, ascending chronological order, matching trial's group-sequential design. element list : events: cumulative event count analysis (final element maximum planned event count). crit: pre-specified critical value test statistic Z analysis (e.g. design$criticalValues rpact group-sequential design). predictive draw, boundaries checked order: Z crosses boundary, draw recorded successful evaluation stops (mirroring group-sequential design's early-stopping logic); final boundary chain reached without crossing, draw recorded unsuccessful. evaluates trial-success event: crossing future efficacy boundary, rejecting \(H_0\) final analysis. Scope: future_boundaries must contain fixed (non-Bayesian) decision points. design one future Bayesian-predictive-probability futility look supported , require nested posterior-predictive simulation look; see package/manuscript Limitations. n_sims Number posterior-predictive draws (required, default).

title: Calculate the predictive probability (PP) given interim data and posterior samples — PP_func
code: set.seed(123) n <- 30 cens_time <- 15  time <- runif(n, 0, 12) rec_time <- runif(n, 0, 12)  df <- data.frame(   time = time,   group = c(rep("Control", n/2), rep("Treatment", n/2)),   rec_time = rec_time )  df$pseudo_time <- df$time + df$rec_time df$status <- df$pseudo_time < cens_time df$survival_time <- ifelse(df$status == TRUE, df$time, cens_time - df$rec_time)  posterior_df <- data.frame(HR = rnorm(20, mean = 0.75, sd = 0.05),                            delay_time = rep(0, 20),                            lambda_c = rnorm(20, log(2)/9, sd = 0.01))  analysis_model <- list(method = "LRT", alpha = 0.025,                        alternative_hypothesis = "one.sided")  # Recommended usage: pass the design's own future boundaries, e.g. a single # efficacy look at 20 events (Z > 2.24) followed by a final analysis at # 28 events (Z > 2.00): future_boundaries <- list(   list(events = 20, crit = 2.24),   list(events = 28, crit = 2.00) )  PP_outcome <- PP_func(df, posterior_df,            control_distribution = "Exponential",            n_c_planned = n/2, n_t_planned = n/2,            rec_time_planned = 12, df_cens_time = 15,            analysis_model = analysis_model,            future_boundaries = future_boundaries,            n_sims = 10)
